<align="center">And Trickery's profanities tarnish its solemn visage.</align>
<align="center">Its noble form, entombed beneath the River of Souls,</align>
<align="center">Is barred from the world by the Titans of Calamity.</align>

<align="center">O great sky father, slumbering Throne of Worlds who upholds the Dawn,</align>
<align="center">Have you sown the seeds of a merciful prophecy,</align>
